articles.summary: THOMASVILLE, Ga., November 4, 2026 – Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE: FLO) today announced that its board of directors has elected Shaun P. Mara and Ken Plunk as independent directors, effective Nov. 18, 2026. The board appointed Mara and Plunk to serve on the audit and finance committees. With the election of the two new directors,...
articles.title: FLOWERS FOODS ELECTS TWO NEW MEMBERS TO BOARD OF DIRECTORS
